data.narrative:
Atopile is a seed-stage company in Robotics & Manufacturing founded by Matthew Wildoer, Narayan Powderly, and Timothée Peter. The company has raised $500K to date. The comparable universe consists of 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public company (277810.KQ), providing sector context though limited strict peer overlap.

Only one valuation method proved applicable to this analysis. Stage-progression methodology, anchoring to the $500K total raised as a proxy for seed-stage valuation and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier to next-stage progression, yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. Peer-median triangulation was not viable due to insufficient data density—while 11 same-sector peers exist in the Robotics & Manufacturing universe, applying same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier filters yielded fewer than three datapoints, making median-based extrapolation unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M to $1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. This range reflects stage-typical progression assumptions rather than market-tested peer comparables. Key uncertainties include (1) the absence of sufficiently similar-staged peers to validate pricing, (2) the proprietary nature of seed-stage robotics valuations, and (3) potential variance in company-specific traction metrics not captured here. This valuation should be updated as additional same-stage or recently-funded robotics comparables become available.
